summary: End-to-end frontend testing of Tailored Tech Solutions Service Catalog + Cart + Checkout flow. All 10 frontend test cases passed: category tabs (AI default + 6 others) render with emojis; filtering works; service cards display emoji icons; ServiceModal opens with full content (name, tagline, summary, includes, benefits, deliverables, industries, pricing breakdown); Add-to-Cart shows green 'Added to Cart' state and bottom toast; nav-cart-count increments on desktop; navigating via nav-cart-button lands on /checkout; cart line items render with emoji and auto-included $49.95 AI Consultation row; Order Summary math is exact for subtotal/total/deposit/balance both at initial load and after qty increment; cart persists in localStorage 'tts:cart:v1' across reload; remove-all returns to empty state with ShoppingBag icon and 'Explore Services' CTA; PayPal placeholder button is present, does not navigate or throw, helper text 'PayPal integration coming soon' shown.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx: `useCart` is imported but no loading/empty-guard on first server-paint — fine for CSR-only React app, but if SSR is ever added, hydration could mismatch (loadCart reads localStorage directly).

CartContext.jsx total/deposit math relies on JS float arithmetic (e.g. 10940.90 stored as 10940.900000000001). UI is fine because formatPrice uses toLocaleString, but if the value is ever POSTed to PayPal it should be rounded with Number.toFixed(2) before transmission.
ServiceModal close button text content uses Lucide X icon; no aria-modal/role='dialog' on the modal container — minor a11y improvement (focus trap, role=dialog) recommended.

Nav.jsx renders BOTH a desktop and mobile cart button at the same time (hidden via Tailwind responsive classes). data-testid 'nav-cart-button' targets desktop only; mobile has 'nav-cart-button-mobile'. This is correctly documented in the request and works as intended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Service catalog + Cart + Checkout end-to-end is verified working including 50% deposit math, $49.95 auto-consultation, localStorage persistence (key 'tts:cart:v1'), and PayPal visual placeholder. data-testids used: service-cat-{id}, service-card-{id}, service-modal-add-to-cart, service-modal-close, nav-cart-button, nav-cart-button-mobile, nav-cart-count, cart-item-{id}, checkout-paypal-button, checkout-back-home. Backend was explicitly skipped per request. PayPal is intentionally a placeholder — do not flag as a bug.
